verdict.rationale: Heap's pricing page lists "CSV exports" and "Data warehouse integration" as plan features. Both are first-party export paths in an open format or destination, but each is only a bullet point. Nothing shows they cover all captured data rather than chart or report results, and they appear tied to specific paid tiers. Missing for 10: documentation that a full raw-data export covers events, users and properties, details on the warehouse sync's scope and formats, availability on every plan, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a user can export everything and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
